facts.fact: 十一月的雾从荒野上滚滚压来，Phil 独自一人走在通往镇子的唯一一条路上
facts.anchor: Mist was rolling in across the moors, thick and heavy

facts.fact: Phil 盘算若 Margot 已经坐火车走了，就在镇上餐馆吃晚饭，好避开学校的晚餐
facts.anchor: she could stop for dinner at one of the local restaurants

facts.fact: Jane 摔门拒绝开车送 Phil 进 Wroxborough 去查看，Phil 觉得 Jane 比平时更小气
facts.anchor: the way Jane had slammed the door on her, and how she hadn’t even agreed to drive Phil into Wroxborough to check

facts.fact: Phil 反过来怀疑 Jane 拒绝插手，是因为觉得 Margot 该得到一次逃跑的机会
facts.anchor: she thought Margot deserved a chance to escape

facts.fact: Phil 仍记得 Jane 对她说的第一句话就是警告她趁早离开
facts.anchor: the warning to get out while she could

facts.fact: 十字路口的路灯下站着 Margot Hamilton 和一个陌生女人
facts.anchor: one of them was Margot Hamilton. The other was a stranger

facts.fact: Margot 被打发走后，Anne Bredon 向 Phil 开价：要她午夜去破坏学校的 wards
facts.anchor: I want you to break the wards

facts.fact: 一只巨型火焰豹子口吐人言留下警告，说他的 seal 下次保护不了她
facts.anchor: Tell him that his seal will not protect you next time
